features.name: Personalized recommendation feed orchestration
steps: A mix of questions, answers, articles, videos, thoughts, etc.
Each content type's structure is presented correctly
features.expected: "Recommended" must present questions/answers/articles/videos/thoughts in a mixed structure; each card type is distinguishable; modules do not cross positions; scrolling loads without duplication.

features.name: Follow-feed aggregation
steps: Aggregate new activity from these objects
After unfollowing the corresponding content relationships change in sync
features.expected: "Following" must aggregate new activity from followed objects; after unfollowing the corresponding content is removed in sync; after a follow-relationship change the feed set updates correctly; the state must persist.

features.name: Ranking display and content navigation
steps: Show the preset hot-list data (ranking snapshot by popularity)
Tapping an item opens the corresponding content details
features.expected: The ranking must show according to the preset snapshot; tapping an entry opens the correct content details; the list position is preserved after returning; the snapshot data matches the display.

features.name: Column discovery and subscription
steps: The subscriber count and button state change
Their content can continue to be consumed afterwards
features.expected: After subscribing, the button state and subscriber count change immediately; the column's content can then be consumed; after unsubscribing it syncs back; the subscription state must persist.

features.name: Circle discovery, joining, and the in-circle content stream
steps: The circle's content enters the consumable range
features.expected: After joining a circle the membership state changes; the circle's content enters the consumable range; after leaving it syncs back; the join/leave state must persist.

features.name: Search suggestions and search-history management
steps: Completing the search writes it into the history
The state persists after clearing the history
features.expected: Suggestions must appear while typing and change with the content; completing the search writes it into the history; the history can be cleared; the cleared state persists and does not return after a refresh.

features.name: Global search and query-context restoration
steps: The query term, result state, and scroll position are preserved
features.expected: The search results cover types such as questions/answers/users/articles; after tapping a result and returning the query term, result state, and scroll position must be preserved.

features.name: Multi-form creation entry orchestration
steps: Tap "+" or the creation entry on the home page
Ask a question / write an answer / post a thought / write an article / post a video
Different creation workflows are entered according to the content type
features.expected: Each creation entry (questions / answers / thoughts / articles / videos) must enter the corresponding workflow; different workflows are distinguishable; the home-page state is preserved after returning.

features.name: Thought publishing and circle sync
steps: Enter a thought on the home page
Syncing to a circle can be selected
Appears in both the feed and the profile
It syncs within the circle according to the configuration
features.expected: After publishing, the thought must appear in both the feed and the profile; with a sync circle selected it is visible within the circle; it is executed according to the configured sync scope.

features.name: Question publishing and theme organization
steps: It can be followed, answered, and have people invited to answer
features.expected: After publishing an independent Question is generated; the topic binding is correct; the new question can be followed/answered; the question information is displayed correctly in the list.

features.name: Rich-text answer editing and publishing configuration
steps: Write an answer to the question
Use editing capabilities such as titles, lists, quotes, code, formulas, images, videos, links, and attachments
features.expected: Rich-text editing capabilities (titles / lists / quotes / code / formulas / images, etc.) render correctly; the publishing configuration (reposting / comments / source) is saved correctly; after publishing the answer is presented in full.

features.name: Long-content publishing workflows such as articles/videos
steps: The content enters the profile and the content feed
features.expected: After editing the content and uploading media it saves correctly; the publishing properties take effect; after publishing the content appears on the profile and in the content feed; a clear state is given on failure.

features.name: Draft auto-save and restore
steps: Content is produced while editing an answer/article
It automatically enters the draft box
After publishing the draft state migrates correctly
features.expected: The draft is auto-saved during editing; after leaving and re-entering the editing state is restored; after publishing the draft state migrates correctly; the draft content is not lost.

features.name: Multi-object aggregation in the question details
steps: Load the title, topic, description, follower count, view count, answer count, answer list, related questions, etc.
All areas stay consistent for the same Question Context
features.expected: The title/topic/description/follower count/view count/answer count/answer list/related questions and other areas must stay consistent for the same Question; the data matches the real content.

features.name: Follow questions and sync question relationships
steps: The follow state and follower count change
It appears among the personally followed questions
After unfollowing both sides disappear in sync
features.expected: After following, the button state and follower count change; the question appears in the personal following list; after unfollowing both sides disappear in sync; the state must persist.

features.name: Invite-to-answer workflow
steps: Open the invitation panel (preset invitable-user list)
The invitation state can be viewed on the question page
features.expected: Opening the invitation panel shows the preset list of invitable users; after sending an invitation the invitation state is recorded correctly; the invitation state can be viewed on the question page; duplicate invitations must not occur.

features.name: Answer sorting and list-state preservation
steps: Switch between default/time and other sorts
The results are reorganized by deterministic rules
The sort changes but the answers' interaction state is not lost
features.expected: After switching the sort mode the results are reorganized by deterministic rules; the sort change does not affect the answers' interaction state (upvotes/comment count); the sort selection is preserved after returning.

features.name: Upvote interaction and answer-state sync
steps: The button state and upvote count change
It is still preserved on the next visit
The data rolls back after cancelling the upvote
features.expected: After upvoting, the button state and upvote count change immediately; revisiting keeps them; after cancelling the upvote the data rolls back correctly; the state must persist.

features.name: Favorites and personal content-library aggregation
steps: It appears in the personal favorites area
After unfavoriting the original content and the favorites list sync
features.expected: After favoriting, the content appears in the personal favorites area; it can be re-entered from the profile; after unfavoriting the original content and the favorites list update in sync.

features.name: Comments and multi-level reply threads
steps: The Thread relationship is preserved after a refresh
features.expected: After posting a comment it appears in the comment area; replies form the correct hierarchy; expanding all replies and switching sorts does not break the thread relationship; the like state on comments is correct; it is preserved after a refresh.

features.name: Follow relationships and list-state sync
steps: That user's content enters the follow feed's consumable range
features.expected: After following, the state changes; the user's content enters the follow feed's consumable range; "people I follow" displays correctly; after unfollowing it syncs back.

features.name: Follower / following list-state management
steps: View "people I follow" and "people who follow me"
Distinguish following, follows you, and mutual follow (relationship data preset)
The local state updates in real time
features.expected: Correctly distinguish following / follows you / mutual follow (relationship data preset); following/unfollowing directly in the list updates the local state in real time; each group's results are correct.

features.name: Notification event center and business-object navigation
features.expected: The preset notifications increase the top badge; tapping a notification opens the correct target (question/answer/user); the notification is marked read; the unread count decreases in sync.

features.name: Private-message sessions and unread-state isolation
steps: The corresponding unread is cleared after reading
features.expected: Each contact's session history is saved independently; switching contacts switches the context correctly; the new-message unread badge is shown correctly; after reading the corresponding unread is cleared.

features.name: Automatic recent-browsing recording and history management
steps: Single deletion, batch deletion, clearing, or disabling of recent browsing is available
features.expected: Browsed content automatically enters recent browsing; it is correctly aggregated by today/yesterday/earlier; single/batch deletion and clearing take effect correctly; after disabling it is no longer recorded.

features.name: Profile aggregation of multiple content types
steps: Aggregate dynamics / answers / videos / questions / articles / columns / thoughts / favorites, etc. by tab
The counts, content, and sorting match the real data
features.expected: The content and counts of each tab (dynamics / answers / videos / questions / articles / columns / thoughts / favorites) must match the real data; the tab state is preserved when switching; sorting is correct.

features.name: Profile editing
features.expected: After editing the profile it saves successfully; the profile updates immediately; the result must persist across refreshes; invalid input should be rejected.

features.name: Creator center and content data
steps: The user enters the creator center
View creation metrics such as reads/plays and upvotes
features.expected: Creation metrics (reads/plays/upvotes, etc.) are displayed correctly; the draft box content matches the state; the metrics update in sync after creation behavior.

features.name: Block / blacklist / privacy preferences driving runtime behavior
steps: Set blocked keywords, a user blacklist, a topic blacklist, and hiding a user's activity
It becomes visible again after undoing
features.expected: After blocking, the corresponding content is filtered from the recommended/following feeds; after undoing it becomes visible again; the settings must persist across refreshes.

features.name: Global behavior events and cross-module consistency
steps: The user performs upvote, follow, favorite, answer, comment, browse, and other behaviors
The follow feed's interaction state, question details, profile, notifications, creator data, relationship counts, and all related areas stay consistent
features.expected: After upvote/follow/favorite/answer/comment/browse behaviors occur, the follow-feed interaction state, question details, profile, notifications, creator data, and relationship counts must stay consistent; single-point omissions must not occur.

exclusions.feature:
Personalized recommendation engine
Feed ranking and content recommendation that change with behavior and interests
exclusions.reason: Requires a recommendation model and behavior data (cf. Spotify "Recommendation / personalization engine"); the feed structure can use preset fixtures

exclusions.feature:
Real-time ranking popularity
Real popularity computation and real-time ranking changes
exclusions.reason: The ranking is presented as a static snapshot (cf. Spotify "Dynamic charts and editorial ranking"); a real-time popularity engine is not required

exclusions.feature:
Answer recommendation ranking algorithm
The ranking algorithm based on factors such as quality and relationships
exclusions.reason: Sort switching and state preservation are testable; the sort uses deterministic rules (time/upvotes); retained surface: f17 answer sorting and list-state preservation

exclusions.feature:
Real delivery and response of invitations
Invited users receive the notification and accept the invitation
exclusions.reason: The invitation operation and state display are testable (preset user list); cross-user delivery is not verified; retained surface: f16 invite-to-answer workflow

exclusions.feature:
Two-way propagation of the user's follow

exclusions.reason: The local follow state is testable; the other side's data is presented via fixtures; retained surface: f21 follow relationships and list-state sync, f22 follower/following list-state management

exclusions.feature:
Real peers in private messages

exclusions.reason: The session UI/unread/isolation is testable (preset sessions); real peers and push are not verified; retained surface: f24 private-message sessions and unread-state isolation

exclusions.feature:
The real event source of notifications
Real generation of invitations/interactions/relationship changes
exclusions.reason: The notification state machine (badge/navigation/read) is testable and requires preset notification fixtures; retained surface: f23 notification event center and business-object navigation

exclusions.feature:
Real-name verification flow
Verification requests, review, and state transitions
exclusions.reason: Depends on an external identity-verification system; personal profile editing is kept; retained surface: f27 personal profile editing

exclusions.feature:
Video transcoding Processing
Media-processing pipelines and transcoding states
exclusions.reason: The upload and publish flow is testable; a real transcoding pipeline is not required (cf. YouTube "transcoding/CDN"); retained surface: f11 rich-text answer editing and publishing configuration

exclusions.feature:
Author-side data changes
Author achievements/data updates from others' upvotes
exclusions.reason: The local upvote state is testable; author-side statistics are out of single-agent scope; retained surface: f18 upvote interaction and answer-state sync

exclusions.feature:
Content safety and moderation policy
Sensitive-content filtering and moderation queues
exclusions.reason: Depends on the platform moderation system and policy data; blocking/blacklist (user-side settings) is kept; retained surface: f29 block / blacklist / privacy preferences driving runtime behavior

exclusions.feature:
"Waiting for you to answer" question recommendations
User-profile-based question recommendations
exclusions.reason: Depends on the recommendation system (cf. the recommendation-engine exclusion); the creator-center metrics are kept; retained surface: f28 creator center and content data

exclusions.feature:
Real content assets
Real Q&A content and user avatar and profile data
exclusions.reason: Use synthetic fixture content (cf. Spotify "Real catalog")
